text.text: The Cisco Nexus7700 Switches are the latest extension to the Nexus 7000 series of modular switches. With more than 42 terabits per second (Tbps) of overall switching capacity, the Cisco Nexus® 7710 Switch delivers up to 384 native 10 Gbps ports, 192 40 Gbps ports and up to 96 100 Gbps ports

text.text: The Cisco Nexus M3-Series Module integrates the broadest set of Data Center switching technologies, including industry standards as well as Cisco’s own innovations. Performance: 48 non-blocking 1/10GE (SFP/SFP+) ports. Large forwarding tables and deeper buffers that enhance gateway functions and traffic handling. VxLAN with BGP-EVPN: wire-rate hardware support along with standards-based overlay that enables multi-tenancy and host mobility. GTP Hashing: enhanced hardware based hashing that leads to more optimal load balancing of GTP packets. Data Center Interconnect (DCI): protocols such as OTV, MPLS and VPLS facilitate transparent interconnects and extension of applications across geographically dispersed data center sites. Locator/ID Separation Protocol (LISP): provides enterprises and service providers the ability to simplify multi-homed routing, and facilitates scalable any-to-any WAN connectivity while supporting data center virtual machine mobility. MACsec: wire-rate with 128- and 256-bit advanced encryption standard (AES) on all ports at all speeds provides enhanced security for data center interconnect, uplink or fabric links. Cisco TrustSec: security-group tags (SGTs) enabled ACLs provide hardware-based enforcement of security policies simplifying management and enhancing scalability. Fabric Services Accelerator (FSA): provides performance and scale boosts during Bidirectional Forwarding Detection (BFD) and Cisco Netflow. Other HW capabilities: Fabric Path and Cisco Nexus 2000 Series Fabric Extenders (FEX) support
